sn33.16:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo || pa || Rūpe kho Vaccha ananubodhā || pa || rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyo ananubodhā || pa || ||
sn33.20:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Viññāṇe kho Vaccha ananubodhā || pa || viññāṇanirodhagāminiyā patipadāya ananubodhā || || Sāvatthi || ||
